aws-cloud-inspector-free 1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Provides AWS CLI-based, read-only cloud infrastructure query and inspection assistant, free for personal/developer routine checks.
- Supports resource inventory, health checks, basic security checks, and dry-run previews.
- Advanced features (security auditing, cost analysis, change management) are restricted to the professional edition.
- Enforces strong safety rules: read-only default, explicit confirmation for changes, region/profile isolation, and never outputs credentials.
- Includes quick start guide, troubleshooting, typical usage scenarios, and references for AWS CLI queries and best practices.
